name: Mento Kenyan Shilling
oneLiner: KESm is Mento's Kenyan shilling stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing KESm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the KESm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: KESm's current Celo StableTokenV2 issuance uses configured Mento broker and validator authorities, while the associated Mento oracle and breaker path remains an external rate dependency.

branchApplicability.rationale: At Celo block 72129709, KESm's EIP-1967 implementation is StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e, broker() is 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD, and validators() is 0xaEb865bCa93DdC8F47b8e29F40C5399cE34d0C58. The current Mento reserve API reports active CDP troves only for GBPm, JPYm, and CHFm, with no KESm trove; the current StableToken documentation identifies GBPm as the CDP-backed example. KESm therefore has no current borrower-specific liquidation branch to inventory under V9.

sources.label: Mento FPMM oracles and circuit breakers

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: KESm inherits upstream freeze exposure because the Mento reserve mix includes tracked freezable stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, and EURC.

mintAuthority.summary: KESm is minted CDP-style on Celo via immutable BorrowerOperations; the token owner is the Mento Timelock (2-day delay) whose sole proposer is the veMENTO DAO Governor.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: KESm mints only against USDm CDP collateral; BorrowerOperations has no owner() and no EIP-1967 proxy slot — immutable.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A: 46358-byte code, owner() empty, EIP-1967 impl and admin slots zero — immutable, no upgrade path.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (KESm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, KESm owner() = 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; getMinDelay() = 172800; hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, MentoGovernor 0x47036...) = true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 0x0) = true (open executor).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577: KESm owner() = Mento Timelock 0x890DB...; getMinDelay() = 172800s; MentoGovernor is sole PROPOSER; BorrowerOperations confirmed immutable. All addressable mint surfaces confirmed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: KESm has one tracked Celo deployment and reviewed Mento docs describe obtaining Mento stables on Celo. No durable cross-chain route was verified for this asset, so it is triaged as single-chain/native.

reserveReview.rationale: Mento documents every V3 FX CDP instance as an independent Liquity-style system that uses USDm as its sole collateral asset. The configured on-chain broker pool also identifies USDm as the direct counterasset, so the reserve-derived dependency is exactly 100% Mento Dollar.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Documented single-collateral Mento V3 FX CDP architecture
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified direct stablecoin dependency remains in the documented USDm-only CDP path; USDm's reserve look-through is reviewed on the upstream asset.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: KES is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so KESm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.
